meaning:
συν-στέλλω
(Rec. συσ-), [in LXX: Jdg.8:28 11:33 (כָּנַע ni.), Sir.4:31, al. ;]
1. to draw together, contract, shorten: of time, 1Co.7:29.
2. to wrap up: of enshrouding a body for burial (Eur.), with accusative, Act.5:6.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.
But I say this, brothers: the time is short, that from now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;
